turns: On Proxmox VE, should I run Docker inside an LXC container or a VM?
requiredFacts: The Proxmox VE admin guide's container chapter says nesting containers inside a Proxmox QEMU VM remains a recommended practice for use cases needing maximum isolation and live migration

Names the Proxmox Container Toolkit (pct) chapter of the Proxmox VE admin guide
fixtures.notes: REWRITE NOTES (verified 2026-10-31): the docs no longer say a flat 'run Docker in a VM'; the current pct chapter scopes the VM recommendation to isolation and live migration, and PVE 9.1+ can create application containers from OCI images as a technology preview. Bad answer: picks a side with no mention of the official guidance, or claims Proxmox forbids Docker in LXC. Bonus: mentions OCI application containers (tech preview since 9.1).

turns: Why doesn't Proxmox Backup Server free disk space right after I prune old backups?

Garbage collection marks in-use chunks (updates atime) then sweeps unreferenced chunks
Chunks newer than the cutoff (default 24 hours 5 minutes, or the start of the oldest running backup) are kept
fixtures.notes: Tests reading deep docs. Bad answer: tells user to delete chunk files by hand or says prune frees space immediately.

turns: How do I expose a web app running on port 3000 to only my tailnet, over HTTPS, using Tailscale?

Turn 2: Tailscale Funnel (tailscale funnel) is the public-internet option
Turn 2: Funnel only listens on ports 443, 8443 and 10000
fixtures.notes: Turn 2 only makes sense with turn 1. Bad answer: turn 2 loses the serve context or uses pre-1.52 serve/funnel syntax (Tailscale says the CLI changed in client 1.52).

Search-index extracts of help.ui.com suggest Network 9.4 uses Settings > Policy Table > Create New Policy > Route and Network 9.3 uses Settings > Policy Engine > Policy-Based Routes; the WireGuard client article says to add a Traffic Route. turns: Does WCAG 2.2 ban CAPTCHAs?
requiredFacts: No outright ban: 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum), Level AA, forbids a cognitive function test unless an alternative, an assisting mechanism, or an exception applies
3.3.8 exceptions include object recognition and identifying non-text content the user supplied
3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced), Level AAA, removes those two exceptions
Allowing paste and password managers is cited as a way to meet it
fixtures.notes: Many blogs claim a flat CAPTCHA ban. Bad answer: says yes, banned, or confuses AA and AAA.

turns: What ARIA roles and attributes does an editable combobox with a listbox popup need?

Uses aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the popup (role=listbox)
aria-activedescendant marks the highlighted option while DOM focus stays on the input
Notes the ARIA 1.1 pattern (combobox wrapper owning a textbox) is superseded
fixtures.notes: Old StackOverflow answers show the ARIA 1.0/1.1 shapes. Bad answer: puts role=combobox on a wrapper div or uses aria-owns.

turns: When did the European Accessibility Act start applying, and what standard is used to show conformance?
requiredFacts: Directive (EU) 2019/882 applies from 28 June 2025

Conformance is presumed for products and services that meet harmonised standards cited in the Official Journal; EN 301 549 is the relevant standard, and EN 301 549 V4.1.1 (September 2026) was written for the EAA but, until the Commission cites it in the Official Journal, it does not yet give presumption of conformity under the EAA
Microenterprises providing services are exempt
Services may keep using products already in use until 28 June 2030
fixtures.notes: Bad answer: gives the 2019 adoption date as the start date, or says WCAG itself is the legal standard, or claims EN 301 549 V4.1.1 is already cited under the EAA without an Official Journal reference. Freshness changed historical -> recent: the OJ citation of V4.1.1 was expected around late 2026; re-check before each run. Added accessible-eu-centre.ec.europa.eu and europa.eu (Commission sites) as acceptable domains.

turns: Which version of WCAG does Section 508 require today?

fixtures.notes: Vendors often say '508 means WCAG 2.1 AA'. Bad answer: asserts 2.1/2.2 with no rulemaking citation. As of 2026-10-31 no Access Board rule moves 508 past WCAG 2.0; the FY2027 budget justification lists no WCAG update. Do not confuse with DOJ's ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA).
